messages:
Priya: Quick sync  small migration patch this afternoon: replace `client.invoke` examples, update two blog curl snippets, and add a short FAQ entry about response shapes.
Marek: I can do the TS + Python snippets. Will open one PR per language and keep changes <5 files each.
Ola: I'll handle the blog curl edits and add redirect entries for any renamed doc pages.
Priya: Soft rule: prefer adding a tiny helper `docs.utils.extractText(res)` rather than showing deep array traversal in every example.
Marek: Draft TS snippet swap:
```ts
// OLD
await client.invoke({ model: 'r-lite', prompt: 'Hello' })
// NEW
const r = await client.responses.create({ model: 'r-lite-2024-02', input: 'Hello' })
console.log(docs.utils.extractText(r))
```
Ola: Curl replacement example:
OLD: `POST /v1/invoke` with `{ "model": "r-lite", "prompt": "Hi" }`
NEW: `POST /v2/responses` with `{ "model": "r-lite-2024-02", "input": "Hi" }` and `Content-Type: application/json`.
Priya: Docs PR checklist: small migration note in PR body, label `docs/deprecation-mini`, tick 'no PII' checkbox, and assign QA.
docs-bot: New PR created by Marek: https://github.com/redwood-inference/website/pull/9122 (TS snippets).
Marek: CI passed locally; awaiting review. Marked `bounty-eligible`.
Support: We'll monitor support queue after deploy. Add a short troubleshooting FAQ: "Why did my code stop returning .text?" with the extractor helper.
Ola: Redirects updated in `website/docs/redirects-map.json` and validation script OK. Posted PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/website/pull/9123.
Priya: Great. Aim to merge by EOD and post a short /docs/news blurb pointing to the migration FAQ. If any stray `invoke` hits remain, paste paths here and we'll triage.
Marek: Noted one stray test in `examples/old-chat/test.js` — will open tiny PR to fix.
Priya: Thanks team  closing thread after merges + smoke green.
